name: Power Of The Word
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power of the Word in transforming lives and guiding faith. The tongue holds the power of life and death, producing lasting fruit (Proverbs 18:21), while Christ's spoken Word cleanses believers (John 15:3). The gospel itself is the power of God for salvation to all who believe (Romans 1:16), and faith arises through hearing God's Word (Romans 10:17). The Word is living and active, discerning the deepest thoughts and intentions (Hebrews 4:12), calling believers not only to hear but to actively obey it (James 1:22). Together, these truths highlight the vital, dynamic role of God's Word in salvation, sanctification, and daily living.
